title: A Radiators for the Language
author: Petra Amberdale
blurb: Hazel Nakamura, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. But when the last speaker of a language asks for one final student, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must forgive the stranger in the old photographs before the mother's memory goes entirely.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
